THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Taco-Seasoned Air-Fryer Chicken Thighs

The chicken is shared; the eating experience is not. Adults get four built tacos with six ounces of chicken and optional green sauce. Each child gets two ounces of chicken deconstructed with guacamole and a lightly ghee-brushed corn tortilla.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME30 min
COOK METHODAir fryer
EST. / SERVING~400 cal | ~35g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Arrange the thighs in one layer with space between pieces. Cook in batches if needed.

Ingredients

SHARED CHICKEN

  • 1 1/2 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs, enough to yield at least 16 oz cooked
  • 2 tbsp taco seasoning, or to taste
  • 1 tbsp avocado oil

Option 1

  • 4 oz cooked taco-seasoned chicken total, 2 oz per child
  • 2 individual guacamole portions, or guacamole to taste
  • Melted ghee for a very light tortilla brush

Option 2

  • 4 oz cooked taco-seasoned chicken total, 2 oz per child
  • 2 individual guacamole portions, or guacamole to taste
  • Melted ghee for a very light tortilla brush

TORTILLAS

  • 8 small corn tortillas for the two adult plates
  • 2-4 additional small corn tortillas for the two kid plates, based on appetite

ADULT GARNISH

  • 1/2 cup white onion, finely diced
  • 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, chopped
  • 1 tbsp lime juice
  • Pinch of salt
  • High-Protein Cilantro Jalapeño Ranch, optional

Allergens: dairy. Green sauce contains dairy

AT PLATING. The taco-seasoned air-fried chicken is shared. Adults get four assembled tacos each; each child gets 2 oz chicken deconstructed with guacamole and a lightly ghee-brushed tortilla.

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.SEASON. Pat the thighs dry, coat with avocado oil, and season all over with taco seasoning.
  2. 2.AIR-FRY. Arrange in one layer. Air-fry at 390°F for about 14-18 minutes, turning once, until the thickest piece reaches at least 165°F. Appliance and thigh thickness change the timing.
  3. 3.REST + CHOP. Rest 5 minutes, then chop into bite-size pieces. Weigh the cooked chicken before building plates.

Adult — Four Chicken Tacos + Optional Green Sauce

  1. 4.ADULT ONION-CILANTRO. Mix the diced onion, cilantro, lime, and salt. Rest 5 minutes to soften the raw-onion edge.
  2. 5.ASSEMBLE. Warm four tortillas per adult. Add 1.5 oz cooked chicken to each, then cilantro-onion and the optional green sauce.

Kid — 2 oz Chicken, Deconstructed + Guacamole · Option 1

  1. 4.SOFTEN THE TORTILLA. Brush very lightly with melted ghee and warm only until pliable.
  2. 5.PLATE. Add 2 oz chopped chicken per child. Keep the chicken, guacamole, and tortilla separate; do not pre-assemble.

Kid — 2 oz Chicken, Deconstructed + Guacamole · Option 2

  1. 4.PLATE. Chopped chicken in one compartment and the lightly ghee-brushed tortilla in another. No adult toppings.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — Four Chicken Tacos + Optional Green Sauce: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid — 2 oz Chicken, Deconstructed + Guacamole: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • Air-fryer timing varies. Cook until the thickest thigh reaches at least 165°F on a food thermometer, then rest 5 minutes.
  • Portion by cooked weight after resting: 1.5 oz per adult taco; 2 oz total per child.

If something fails

Chicken is pale instead of browned: The basket was crowded or the surface was wet. Pat the thighs dry and leave space between them; cook a second batch if needed.

Chicken is dry: It cooked past temperature or was sliced without resting. Check the thickest piece with a thermometer and rest 5 minutes before chopping.

Seasoning tastes dusty: The dry seasoning never hydrated. Coat the thighs evenly with a small amount of oil before adding the taco seasoning.

Kid tortilla turns hard: Warm it only until pliable and brush it very lightly with ghee. Serve immediately rather than leaving it exposed while the adult tacos are assembled.

Kids reject the whole plate: Return to the filmed split: 2 oz chicken, guacamole, and tortilla separated. They can combine the parts themselves or eat them independently.

Adult tacos feel flat: Add lime and salt to the cilantro-onion mixture, then use the optional green sauce for cool herb flavor and jalapeño tang.

Storage and reheating

Store: Store cooked chicken, tortillas, cilantro-onion, guacamole, and green sauce separately. Refrigerate the chicken within 2 hours.

Reheat: Reheat only the chicken until hot, then warm tortillas just before serving. Add cold guacamole and green sauce after reheating.

Lasts: Cooked chicken: 3-4 days refrigerated. Cilantro-onion is best the same day. Follow the guacamole and green-sauce storage guidance on their own packages or recipe pages.

Estimated nutrition

~400 cal | ~35g protein.
